hero.lead: The queue does not care that it is Sunday, and neither does the customer who ordered Friday night. A dedicated full-time CX specialist clears the weekend before your Monday and leaves a short list of the orders that actually need a decision from you, with the thread and the tracking already pulled. One DTC brand has run the same full-time CX seat for nearly four years, and it has never turned over.

faq.q: Will my CSAT dip while they ramp?
faq.a: For the first two weeks, expect slower handling on edge cases while they learn your SKUs, your return windows, and which customers are repeat buyers. Weeks two and three are when your macros get rewritten, because they will have found the ones that are wrong. Judge the seat at week six, not week two. Anyone who tells you a new CX hire is at full speed on day three has not run a queue.

faq.q: Can they issue refunds or see card numbers?
faq.a: They never see full payment details. Your operator works inside the masked views your platform already provides, under NDA, with the refund, discount, and replacement limits you set. Anything above those limits routes to you. Access is granted by you and can be pulled anytime.

faq.q: How is this different from a BPO or an agency that sends a team?
faq.a: A pooled team means whoever is on shift, and nobody ever learns that your size chart runs small or that a specific carrier scan always means a lost package. You get one named person, full time, in your queue every day, who shows up in your Slack. Our placements hold a 98% retention rate, and if a fit is not right we re-match you at no cost.

faq.q: How much does a full-time seat cost?
faq.a: Full-time seats start at $1,800 per month. Pricing depends on the role, experience level, and coverage window. Each plan includes management, payroll, benefits, and support, in one monthly invoice.

faq.q: How does the 40 hour free trial work?
faq.a: Once you pick who to meet and interview them, your matched operator does 40 hours of real work in your queue, on us. Not a test project or a demo. If it clicks, you keep them. If it does not, you walk away clean.

faq.q: What tools do they work in?
faq.a: Whatever you already run. Most of our DTC seats live in Shopify plus a helpdesk, usually Gorgias or Zendesk, with experience across Loop, ReCharge, Klaviyo, Aftership, and the carrier portals. We match for your stack before you interview.

faq.q: Do they actually understand DTC support?
faq.a: Yes, and this is the difference that matters. A generalist treats every ticket as a question to answer. We match you with someone who knows the difference between a scan that is stalled and a package that is gone, an exchange that is still inside the window and one that has to become a refund, and a dispute with a delivery scan behind it versus one you are going to lose. They work the queue by what it costs you, not by what came in first.

faq.q: We already have an AI chatbot. Why add a person?
faq.a: Keep the bot. It should be handling order status lookups and FAQ deflection, and it is cheap at that. What it cannot do is decide whether a customer on their second replacement gets a third, or write the dispute response that keeps the money. Those are the tickets that turn into refunds and one-star reviews, and they are what the seat is for.

faq.q: Will I have to manage them?
faq.a: No. A dedicated Client Success Manager runs onboarding, monitors performance, and handles the day to day. You delegate the work and review the output. You are not building an offshore HR function.

faq.q: How long does it take to get matched?
faq.a: You will receive your shortlist within 5 to 10 days. Specialized roles may take longer. Once you have chosen a candidate and completed interviews, you can get started right away.

faq.q: Can I add a second seat later?
faq.a: Yes, and most brands do. Once the first seat owns the day-to-day queue, the usual next hires are a second specialist for weekend and peak coverage, or a CX Manager to own the queue outright. We match from the same bench so the second person ramps against someone who already knows your catalog.

faq.q: Can I replace my operator later on?
faq.a: Yes. If your needs change or performance dips, we will replace your talent at no additional cost.

faq.q: Do you provide ongoing support after hiring?
faq.a: Yes. A dedicated Client and VA Success Manager monitors performance, facilitates feedback, and ensures both sides are supported long term.

faq.q: What is included in your management and payroll service?
faq.a: We handle contracts, payments, compliance, productivity tracking, and full suite benefits. You get one monthly invoice for everything.

faq.q: Can I buy out my operator?
faq.a: Yes. Buyouts are allowed as long as the talent agrees, with flexibility based on hours, tenure, and subscription tier.
In the Philippines. Senior, college-educated, English-fluent professionals who work a full overlap shift on your business hours and are vetted before you ever meet them.

No long term contracts. Managed Talent is a month to month subscription. Seats are full time, because a queue that spikes after every drop does not get covered by someone who is only there on Tuesdays.
